mechanism: Echinacea may induce CYP3A4 metabolism of dronedarone, potentially reducing its antiarrhythmic efficacy, while also possessing immunostimulatory properties that could theoretically affect cardiac stability.
action: Monitor cardiac rhythm and dronedarone efficacy; consider alternative immune support if possible, and advise patients to maintain consistent echinacea dosing or discontinue to avoid fluctuating dronedarone levels.
